Library Rules and Regulations
Identity Card is required for access.
Maintain silence and order inside the library.
Students can borrow up to
four books
.
Late returns will incur fines.
Lost books must be replaced or paid for.
Marking/writing in books is strictly prohibited.
Reference books are available for in-library study only.
Borrower cards are non-transferable.
Tearing pages from books/newspapers is strictly forbidden.
Students must return their library cards to obtain a "No-Due" certificate.
